title: Cyber Kill Chain Phases with Defensive Controls
description: An interactive Mermaid flow of the seven Cyber Kill Chain phases, each paired with the defensive controls that disrupt it, illustrating that breaking the chain at any single phase defeats the attack.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Map each Cyber Kill Chain phase to the defensive controls that disrupt it.
Explain why breaking the chain at any single phase defeats the overall attack.
prerequisites: Basic idea of an attack lifecycle and security controls

instructionalStrategies: Hover each phase and have students name which control they would prioritize and why.
Discuss why stopping early phases is cheaper than stopping late ones.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which controls disrupt the Delivery phase, and what attacker action are they blocking?
If you could only fund controls for two phases, which would you pick and why?
